clips.title: The story
paras: Dispatched by Tallow from Tarren Mill, Horde champions are directed across the mountains into the Arathi Highlands to relieve the embattled settlement of Hammerfall. Before reporting to Drum Fel, adventurers must prove their battle readiness against the brutish Boulderfist ogres lurking near the ruins of Stromgarde.

In Tarren Mill, Tallow harbors little patience for untested adventurers wandering through the Foothills. Seeing undisciplined recruits standing idle while distant allies bleed, he directs capable fighters east through Thoradin's Wall into the Arathi Highlands. The Horde outpost of Hammerfall stands besieged on multiple fronts, but Tallow refuses to send warm bodies unless they have proven their worth against substantial opposition first.

Rather than allowing recruits to stumble blindly into Hammerfall, Tallow demands a demonstration of martial strength at the ogre mound northeast of Stromgarde. The Boulderfist tribe maintains a heavy presence in Arathi, their hulking ogres and enforcers posing an immediate threat to anyone traveling the highland trails. Slaying these brutes serves both to thin the hostile forces flanking the road and to ensure that only capable warriors arrive at the outpost.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Weaklings... All of them. You, adventurer, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it?
The Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.

But before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have not the time to sharpen my axe, let alone leave the outpost to slay those beasts that would try and slay my kin.
You do not seem to have the experience of a grunt let alone a full-fledged adventurer, what do you want, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you think you're strong enough to help Hammerfall? So be it.

Tallow either sent you to that ogre mound in the hopes that you would kill yourself or he thinks you're strong enough to aid us. Either way, you're here now and I am in need of more soldiers in our fight against the constant attacks.
If you plan on staying in Hammerfall then get some rest, and come speak to me again when you're ready. There's no shortage of fighting to be had.
